decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive and powerful creatures that can quickly overwhelm your opponent. The key strategy is to control the board and apply pressure with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco. The deck also utilizes Leyline of the Guildpact to protect your creatures and Leyline Binding to control your opponent's board. By ramping into powerful multicolor spells like Tribal Flames, the deck can deal significant damage in a short amount of time, giving you a strong advantage in the early game.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to maintain board control and pressure opponents. The key strategy is to deploy early threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while using disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt their game plan. The addition of cards like Blood Moon and Molten Collapse also helps to further disrupt the opponent's mana base, giving the deck an edge in the matchup. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo as quickly as possible by utilizing lands that produce multiple mana, such as Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber, along with Amulet of Vigor to untap them and generate a lot of mana each turn. This allows the player to quickly ramp into Primeval Titan and search for powerful utility lands like Vesuva and Boros Garrison to further accelerate their game plan, eventually overwhelming the opponent with massive threats like Cultivator Colossus and Otawara, Soaring City.

This deck focuses on ramping quickly with Amulet of Vigor to play Primeval Titan and trigger land abilities for massive value. It utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor key pieces, such as The One Ring or Cultivator Colossus. Dryad of the Ilysian Grove helps fix mana and provides additional land drops. The deck can quickly assemble a lethal Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle combo with Primeval Titan, or create a massive board presence with multiple land drops in a single turn. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast mana acceleration and powerful threats.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly and efficiently ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor, allowing the player to cast powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus early in the game. The deck also utilizes land-based synergies with cards like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber, while also being able to tutor for key pieces with cards like Summoner's Pact and Tolaria West. The goal is to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and land-based combos.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with cascade, gaining advantage by casting two spells for the price of one. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Scion of Draco, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help protect these threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Utilizing a mix of removal and counter magic, this deck aims to maintain control of the game while aggressively deploying its threats. Mixing powerful creatures and cascade spells, this deck aims to outvalue and overrun the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly putting +1/+1 counters on its creatures, especially with Hardened Scales, to create powerful threats that can overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes artifacts and lands like Urza's Saga to generate additional value and provide protection. The deck includes a variety of creatures that benefit from the counter manipulation, such as Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and Walking Ballista. By efficiently building up creatures and utilizing synergies, the deck aims to quickly take control of the game and push for a fast victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea to cheat out powerful creatures like Generous Ent and Curator of Mysteries. By cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Grief, the deck can easily fill up the graveyard and then cast Living End to bring back all of the creatures from the graveyard for a huge swing in board presence. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Subtlety and Force of Negation to control the game until it can pull off the combo.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan through a combination of hand disruption, board wipes, and targeted removal spells. It utilizes powerful cards like Torment of Hailfire and Dark Petition to generate card advantage and close out the game. With a strong mana base centered around Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, the deck aims to outvalue and outgrind the opponent in a long game, ultimately overwhelming them with its powerful spells and resource management.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. It includes cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Chord of Calling, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Grist, the Hunger Tide to tutor for specific creatures and combo off. The deck also includes cards like Dryad Arbor, Misty Rainforest, and Verdant Catacombs to ensure mana fixing and flexibility in playing different creatures. With a mix of combo pieces, utility creatures, and support cards, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with unexpected interactions and synergies.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using land bounce effects like Simic Growth Chamber and Amulet of Vigor, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. It also utilizes strong supplementary cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The Mycosynth Lattice to help fix mana and provide additional value. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and massive amounts of damage.

The deck focuses on using control elements like countering spells and board wipes to slow down the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes card advantage through Narset, Parter of Veils and Lórien Revealed to stay ahead in resources. The key card, The One Ring, acts as a win condition by giving the player significant advantage once it's activated. The deck also has a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, to provide additional value and synergy with the rest of the cards. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to set up a win condition using Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By ramping up mana with cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Magda, the Hoardmaster, and controlling the board with cards like Relic of Progenitus, Lightning Bolt, and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to reach a critical mass of resources to deal lethal damage to the opponent with Valakut triggers. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of powerful control spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's plans and ultimately win the game. The key strategy revolves around leveraging the efficiency of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to maintain board control while deploying threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending helps to deal with a variety of threats, making the deck versatile and adaptable in different matchups.

This deck focuses on using Hardened Scales to bolster the +1/+1 counter synergies within the deck, creating a powerful Aggro strategy. The deck includes cards like Arcbound Ravager, Inkmoth Nexus, and Walking Ballista to quickly build up and distribute counters on creatures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of threat creatures early in the game, utilizing cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and Patchwork Automaton for additional synergy. The deck also includes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Pendelhaven to provide consistency and protection for its creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt help clear the way for your creatures to attack. With a mix of early aggression and disruptive elements, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.
